cases.prompt: Wi-Fi aur internet ek hi cheez hain kya? Hinglish mein 3 short points aur ek simple example do.
cases.answer:
Wi-Fi aur internet ek hi cheez hain kya? Hinglish mein 3 short points aur ek simple example do.
⋯

Wi‑Fi ek wireless technology hai jo devices (phone, laptop, etc.) ko local network se jodti hai.

Internet worldwide network hai jisme millions of computers aur servers connected hote hain; ye data exchange ka global platform hai.

Wi‑Fi sirf ek medium (wireless link) hai jo aapko local network ke through internet ya local resources tak pahunchata hai; Wi‑Fi bina internet ke bhi ho sakta hai (e.g., aap apne phone ko Wi‑Fi hotspot bana ke local file sharing kar sakte ho).

Simple example:
Aapke ghar ka router Wi‑Fi signal broadcast karta hai. Aapka phone Wi‑Fi se connect hota hai → router se internet request (like YouTube video) bhejta hai → ISP ke network ke through internet tak pahunchta hai → video aapke phone par aata hai. Yahan Wi‑Fi = local wireless link, internet = global data network.

cases.prompt: Python mein list aur tuple ka difference 4 points mein batao aur chhota runnable example do.
cases.answer:
Python mein list aur tuple ka difference 4 points mein batao aur chhota runnable example do.
⋯

Python mein List vs Tuple – 4 key differences

Mutability (Badalne ki ability)

List mutable hoti hai – elements ko add, remove ya modify kar sakte ho.

Tuple immutable hoti hai – ek baar banane ke baad uske elements ko change nahi kar sakte.

Syntax

List ko square brackets [] se likhte hain: my_list = [1, 2, 3]

Tuple ko parentheses () (ya comma) se likhte hain: my_tuple = (1, 2, 3)
(single element tuple ke liye trailing comma zaroori hota hai: single = (5,))

Performance

Tuple immutable hone ki wajah se memory aur speed dono mein thodi faster hoti hai, especially jab large data ko read‑only rakhna ho.

List thodi slower hoti hai kyunki usme dynamic resizing aur mutation support hota hai.

Use‑case

List: jab data ko runtime mein modify karna ho (e.g., building a collection, appending results).

Tuple: jab data constant rahe aur accidental change se bachana ho (e.g., function arguments, dictionary keys).

Chhota runnable example
python
# List example (mutable)
my_list = [10, 20, 30]
print("Original list:", my_list)

my_list.append(40)          # element add kar rahe hain
my_list[1] = 25             # second element modify kar rahe hain
print("Modified list:", my_list)

# Tuple example (immutable)
my_tuple = (10, 20, 30)
print("\nOriginal tuple:", my_tuple)

# Trying to modify will raise an error
try:
    my_tuple[1] = 25
except TypeError as e:
    print("Tuple modification error:", e)

# Tuple can be used as a dictionary key
sample_dict = {my_tuple: "value"}
print("\nDictionary with tuple key:", sample_dict)

Output (expected):

Original list: [10, 20, 30]
Modified list: [10, 25, 30, 40]

Original tuple: (10, 20, 30)
Tuple modification error: 'tuple' object does not support item assignment

Dictionary with tuple key: {(10, 20, 30): 'value'}

Is example se aap dekh sakte ho ki list ko aage badha sakte hain, jabki tuple ko change karne ki koshish par error aata hai, aur tuple ko dictionary key ke roop mein safely use kiya ja sakta hai.

Use‑case

List: jab data ko runtime mein modify karna ho (e.g., building a collection, appending results).

Chhota runnable example
python
# List example (mutable)
my_list = [10, 20, 30]
print("Original list:", my_list)

Output (expected):

Original list: [10, 20, 30]
Modified list: [10, 25, 30, 40]

Original tuple: (10, 20, 30)
Tuple modification error: 'tuple' object does not support item assignment

Dictionary with tuple key: {(10, 20, 30): 'value'}

Is example se aap dekh sakte ho ki list ko aage badha sakte hain, jabki tuple ko change karne ki koshish par error aata hai, aur tuple ko dictionary key ke roop mein safely use kiya ja sakta hai.

Tuple ke andar list ho to kya us list ko change kar sakte hain? Pichhle answer ka ye exception code se samjhao.
⋯
Tuple ke andar list – kya change kar sakte hain?

Tuple khud immutable hoti hai, matlab tuple object ka reference (ya uske elements ka order) change nahi hota.

Lekin tuple ke elements koi bhi Python object ho sakte hain – numbers, strings, lists, dictionaries, etc.

Agar ek element mutable object (jaise list) hai, to us object ke internal data ko modify karna allowed hai, kyunki hum tuple ko hi nahi, balki uske andar ke list ko change kar rahe hain.

Simple example with try‑except
python
# Tuple jisme ek list hai
my_tuple = (1, [10, 20, 30], 3)

print("Original tuple:", my_tuple)

# List ko modify karna – ye allowed hai
my_tuple[1][0] = 99          # first element of the inner list change
my_tuple[1].append(40)       # new element add

print("\nAfter modifying the inner list:")
print("Tuple now looks like:", my_tuple)

# Tuple ke khud ke element ko change karne ki koshish – ye error deta hai
try:
    my_tuple[0] = 100        # try to change the first element of the tuple
except TypeError as e:
    print("\nTuple mutation error:")
    print(e)

Expected output

Original tuple: (1, [10, 20, 30], 3)

After modifying the inner list:
Tuple now looks like: (1, [99, 20, 30, 40], 3)

Tuple mutation error:
'tuple' object does not support item assignment
Kyun aisa hota hai?

my_tuple[1] ek list object ka reference hai. List mutable hoti hai, isliye uske elements (my_tuple[1][0], append()) ko change kar sakte hain.

my_tuple[0] = 100 ka matlab hai tuple ke first slot ko naya object assign karna. Ye slot khud immutable hai, isliye TypeError milta hai.

Summary (3 quick points)
Aspect	Tuple (overall)	List inside Tuple

Mutability
	
Immutable (cannot reassign elements)
	
Mutable (elements can be changed)


Example change
	
my_tuple[0] = 5 → Error
	
my_tuple[1][2] = 99 → Works


Typical use
	
Fixed collection, safe as dict key
	
Use when you need a read‑only container but still want mutable sub‑data

Is tarah, tuple ke andar ki list ko aap freely modify kar sakte hain, lekin tuple ke khud ke positions ko change nahi kar sakte.

cases.prompt: 12 V battery se 6 ohm resistor connected hai. Current aur power nikalo, units aur formula ka meaning basics se samjhao.
cases.answer:
12 V battery se 6 ohm resistor connected hai. Current aur power nikalo, units aur formula ka meaning basics se samjhao.
⋯

1. Basic formulae

Ohm’s Law: \( I = \dfrac{V}{R} \)

\(I\) = current (unit ampere, symbol A) – kitna charge per second flow ho raha hai.

\(V\) = voltage (unit volt, symbol V) – electric “pressure” jo charge ko push karti hai.

\(R\) = resistance (unit ohm, symbol Ω) – material ka opposition to current flow.

Power: \( P = V \times I \) (also \(P = I^{2}R\) ya \(P = \dfrac{V^{2}}{R}\))

\(P\) = power (unit watt, symbol W) – kitni energy per second use ho rahi hai.

2. Given values

Voltage \(V = 12\) V (battery)

Resistance \(R = 6\) Ω

3. Current calculation

\[ I = \frac{V}{R} = \frac{12\ \text{V}}{6\ \text{Ω}} = 2\ \text{A} \]

So, 2 amperes of current flow through the resistor.

4. Power calculation

Using \(P = V \times I\):

\[ P = 12\ \text{V} \times 2\ \text{A} = 24\ \text{W} \]

(You can check with the other forms: \(I^{2}R = 2^{2} \times 6 = 24\) W, or \(V^{2}/R = 12^{2}/6 = 144/6 = 24\) W – all give the same result.)

5. What the units mean

Symbol	Unit	What it measures

V
	
volt (V)
	
Electric potential difference (pressure)


Ω
	
ohm (Ω)
	
Resistance – how much a material resists current


A
	
ampere (A)
	
Current – flow of electric charge per second


W
	
watt (W)
	
Power – energy used per second (1 W = 1 J/s)

6. Quick check

A 9 V battery is connected to a 3 Ω resistor. What will be the current (in A) and the power (in W)? Try solving it using the same steps.

cases.prompt: NaCl पानी में घुलने पर क्या होता है? पाँच आसान वाक्यों में समझाओ; Na और Cl में क्या फर्क है?
cases.answer:
NaCl पानी में घुलने पर क्या होता है? पाँच आसान वाक्यों में समझाओ; Na और Cl में क्या फर्क है?
⋯

जब NaCl (सोडियम क्लोराइड) को पानी में डालते हैं तो पानी के ध्रुवीय अणु NaCl के क्रिस्टल को तोड़ते हैं।

Na⁺ आयन (सकारात्मक) और Cl⁻ आयन (नकारात्मक) अलग‑अलग होकर पानी के अणुओं के चारों ओर घेर लेते हैं, जिससे वे घुल जाते हैं।

पानी के हाइड्रोजन भाग नकारात्मक क्लोराइड आयन को आकर्षित करते हैं, जबकि ऑक्सीजन भाग सकारात्मक सोडियम आयन को।

इस प्रक्रिया को जलनिलयन (डिसॉल्यूशन) कहते हैं और परिणामस्वरूप एक समान रूप से वितरित आयनिक घोल बनता है।

Na (सोडियम) एक धातु है, इलेक्ट्रॉन खोकर +1 आवेश वाला आयन बनता है; Cl (क्लोरीन) एक अधातु है, इलेक्ट्रॉन प्राप्त कर -1 आवेश वाला आयन बनता है, इसलिए उनका रासायनिक व्यवहार अलग है।

Equation: 2x + 5 = 17 Task: x ke liye solve karo, dono steps explain karo.

Solve (2 steps)

Step 1 — 5 ko hatao (subtract 5 from both sides):

2x + 5 = 17 mein, x ke saath +5 juda hua hai. Usse alag karne ke liye dono taraf se 5 minus karo:

2x = 17 − 5 2x = 12

Why: Equation ka balance banana hai — jo ek taraf karo, wahi doosri taraf bhi karo. +5 ko cancel karne ka opposite operation hai −5.

Step 2 — 2 se divide karo (divide both sides by 2):

2x = 12 ka matlab hai "2 × x = 12". x ko akela karne ke liye dono taraf ko 2 se divide karo:

x = 12 / 2 x = 6

Why: 2x matlab 2 × x hai. Multiplication ko undo karne ka opposite operation hai division.

Check

6 put karo: 2(6) + 5 = 12 + 5 = 17 ✓

Ek chhota practice: 3x − 4 = 11 mein x kitna hoga? Dono steps wahi logic use karo.
